title: AST does not explain decisions, emotion, memory or creativity

statements.text: AST does not explain most mental processes, such as deciding, feeling emotions, remembering or creativity. It explains why, having done these, people sometimes claim the process came with a conscious experience, and it does not posit an actual intangible feeling.

sources.locator: What AST Can and Cannot Explain
sources.quote: First, it cannot explain most mental processes, such as how we make decisions, have emotions, or remember the past.

sources.locator: What AST Can and Cannot Explain
sources.quote: Second, an attention schema cannot explain creativity.
